Standard.Name: AudioText Play_residents_6608650: I am entrusting this matter to you!
AudioText Play_residents_6608651: I'm approaching you with a special request...
AudioText Play_residents_6608652: Will you support our cause?
AudioText Play_residents_6608653: You certainly could help me with this, inshallah!
AudioText Play_residents_6608660: I trust in Allah and your assistance!
AudioText Play_residents_6608661: Don’t forget that you gave your word!
AudioText Play_residents_6608670: Were you already able to fulfil my request?
AudioText Play_residents_6608671: Would it be possible for you to handle my case?
AudioText Play_residents_6608680: In that case, I shall exercise patience...
AudioText Play_residents_6608681: My question clearly came at an inconvenient time...
AudioText Play_residents_6608690: Shukran! You have my most sincere thanks!
AudioText Play_residents_6608691: Thank you! You take your obligations very seriously...
AudioText Play_residents_6608700: It was the will of Allah…
AudioText Play_residents_6608701: What an unfortunate undertaking...
AudioText Play_residents_6608710: The Sultan would be furious if he heard about this!
AudioText Play_residents_6608711: Living in your Town is simply too much to bear!
AudioText Play_residents_6608712: The way we are forced to live here is outrageous!
AudioText Play_residents_6608713: I am getting out of here immediately; there is nothing more to make me stay!
AudioText Play_residents_6608714: Settle the grievances before this City perishes…
AudioText Play_residents_6608720: This wretched existence here is most depressing…
AudioText Play_residents_6608721: It is undignified for People to live like this...
AudioText Play_residents_6608722: Why does Allah allow us to live here like this?!
AudioText Play_residents_6608723: By Allah! We deserve better than this!
AudioText Play_residents_6608724: Don't you intend to do anything to improve the situation here?
AudioText Play_residents_6608730: It was a good idea to settle here!
AudioText Play_residents_6608731: I must confess that I feel thoroughly at home in your Settlement...
AudioText Play_residents_6608732: You do the best you can for this Settlement; that's plain to see...
AudioText Play_residents_6608733: Life here is simple, but pleasing to Allah!
AudioText Play_residents_6608734: With Allah's help, we'll turn this Settlement into a flourishing oasis...
AudioText Play_residents_6608740: You run this Town with great wisdom!
AudioText Play_residents_6608741: This place is turning into a real jewel!
AudioText Play_residents_6608742: We have your prudent actions to thank for our Wealth!
AudioText Play_residents_6608743: Anyone who complains about this Town must be a liar...
AudioText Play_residents_6608744: Our honourable Sultan would be most impressed by your abilities...
AudioText Play_residents_6608750: It's wonderful here! I'm sure Allah will forgive me if I postpone my pilgrimage for a while...
AudioText Play_residents_6608751: This Town is worthy of a Sultan, no less!
AudioText Play_residents_6608752: By Allah! Our Town is a haven of Satisfaction!
AudioText Play_residents_6608753: We wouldn't be any better off at the Sultan's court!
AudioText Play_residents_6608754: For the first time in my life, I'm perfectly content!
AudioText Play_residents_6608760: Why should more Envoys move here? Without adequate Provisions...
AudioText Play_residents_6608761: Many of us are simply used to the luxury of the Sultan's palace!
AudioText Play_residents_6608762: If you wish to attract more Envoys to your City, you will have to offer them much more!
AudioText Play_residents_6608763: In Envoy circles it is said that the Supplies in your City would be too inadequate to allow one to live here comfortably...
AudioText Play_residents_6608764: A little more affluence, and more Envoys are sure to move in here, inshallah!
AudioText Play_residents_6608765: Many Envoys do not want to come and live in your City; they say it's too provincial… Well…
AudioText Play_residents_6608766: A few Houses won't be enough to attract more Envoys here!
AudioText Play_residents_6608767: Don't you think you should offer People like me something more?
AudioText Play_residents_6608768: I am afraid that Envoys will refuse to move here until you have provided all the necessary comforts!
AudioText Play_residents_6608769: The demands of many Envoys have increased even more…
